visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair wears a black mask and a grey ribbed short-sleeved top with matching pants. She stands in a spacious airport terminal with white tiled floors. In the background, there is an Emirates business class check-in counter with red signage and digital screens. She holds a green passport and points to it while smiling with her eyes. Yellow text overlays appear on the screen. (2) The scene shifts to the woman squatting next to a beige-colored hardshell carry-on suitcase. She opens the front compartment to reveal various items including a cup of instant noodles, a black hat, and snack packages. The lighting is bright and even, characteristic of an indoor terminal. She gestures towards the contents with enthusiastic hand movements. (3) Inside an airplane cabin, the woman is seen sitting in a seat. She wears a grey neck pillow and white earbuds. The shot captures her feet in white sneakers resting on an inflatable blue foot cushion placed on the floor. She is covered with a dark grey blanket, appearing to sleep comfortably. The cabin lighting is dim with soft highlights from reading lamps. (4) Back in the airport waiting area, the woman demonstrates the suitcase again. She taps the top of the beige suitcase, which has a distinct logo 'Acer' in the center. She shows how easily the front panel opens to retrieve a cup of noodles. The camera uses close-up shots to emphasize the ease of use and the texture of the suitcase material.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with an excited and friendly tone. The background music is a fast-paced electronic pop track with a strong, driving beat and synthesizer melodies. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition, followed by a bright 'ding' sound as the speaker introduces the topic. (2) As the narration continues at a high speed, every transition between visual tips is accented with a playful 'pop' or 'sparkle' sound effect. The ambient noise floor is extremely clean, indicating a professional voice-over layered onto the music. The beat remains steady, providing a constant rhythmic drive. (3) The vocal delivery remains animated with frequent upward pitch inflections. A soft 'thud' and 'rustle' sound effect is heard as items are packed, followed by a 'riser' effect that builds tension before a transition. The music stays consistent in volume, sitting comfortably below the voice. (4) In the final segment, the speaker encourages viewer interaction. A metallic 'click' sound effect coincides with the suitcase being handled. The music concludes with a rhythmic stinger hit. The overall audio design is dense and fast-paced, mirroring the rapid visual editing style of the video.
